rationale: Price is consolidating in an extremely tight range (~$21.00–21.02) with a 5-min ATR of only $0.02, offering no mechanical edge for a directional entry — the compression makes stop placement almost meaningless relative to spread costs. Although relative volume is elevated (4.95x) and price remains above both the 5-min VWAP and session VWAP, the instrument has already pulled back ~2% from the day's high with no identifiable news catalyst, leaving the next directional impulse ambiguous. With today's P&L already negative and no structural level providing a clear asymmetric setup, passing preserves capital for a higher-conviction opportunity.
